partnershipPlan: A radiologist, a surgeon and an emergency physician review the checklist before the switch; results are discussed at month 3.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At three in the morning I need the appendix diameter in the first line, not paragraph four.

summary: Three composite voices on speed of finding, complex cases and waiting.
